# ESM-2 tokenizer fixture

The vocabulary and configuration are unchanged copies from Meta's
`facebook/esm2_t30_150M_UR50D` Hugging Face repository at commit
`a695f6045e2e32885fa60af20c13cb35398ce30c` (MIT license).

Source: https://huggingface.co/facebook/esm2_t30_150M_UR50D/tree/a695f6045e2e32885fa60af20c13cb35398ce30c

These small assets support offline token-layout and residue-mask tests.
They contain no model weights. Asset checksums are recorded in SPEC-0003 and
`pclass_dark.embeddings.ASSET_HASHES`.
